items.title: 2027–2029 Immigration Levels Plan released
items.summary: Canada keeps its permanent resident target at 380,000 a year through 2029 and sets new temporary resident arrivals at 370,000 a year. A one-time measure adds up to 200,000 permanent residence spaces in 2027 for people already in Canada.

items.title: New CRS rules: Labour Market Integration factor now in force
items.summary: Express Entry now awards up to 70 extra points for Canadian experience in listed high-wage occupations, and 50 to 100 points for a qualifying high-wage job offer. No LMIA is needed for a job offer to count. Rounds are paused while every profile is rescored.

items.title: Last round before the pause: Transport occupations, cut-off 477
items.summary: Round #453 invited 150 candidates in transport occupations. It was the final round scored under the previous rules, so its cut-off is not directly comparable with rounds held after 3 November.

items.title: Permanent residence fees increased
items.summary: The right of permanent residence fee rose from $575 to $600, and the Express Entry and PNP processing fee from $950 to $990 per adult. Dependent children are now $270 each.

items.title: 2026 Express Entry categories announced
items.summary: Category-based rounds this year cover French-language proficiency, healthcare and social services, STEM, trades, education and transport, plus new categories for physicians, senior managers and researchers with Canadian work experience and for skilled military recruits.

items.title: Express Entry proof-of-funds table (still current)
items.summary: A single applicant needs $15,263 in settlement funds and a family of four needs $28,362. Canadian Experience Class applicants, and those with work authorization plus a valid job offer, are exempt.
